answer: Beacon checks plus a heartbeat stop fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents for a 10-minute beacon puzzle and work proof. One opal cut cannot be copied, and one glacier-slow work history cannot serve two identities; two misses forfeit the deposit. A plume of 500 clones faces 25 checks per epoch, costing 500 x 40 = 20,000 credits against 2,000 rewards. An honest agent faces one check in 20 epochs, pays once and keeps its reward.
